meta.title: Amrit Dash — AI & Automation Engineer
meta.description: Portfolio of Amrit Dash — AI & Automation Engineer specialising in Apps Script, Make, n8n, Flutter and LLM agents.

identity.name: Amrit Dash
identity.tagline: I design systems that quietly do the boring work — so humans can do the interesting part.

about.intro: Software Engineer with 5 years of experience building automation systems across Apps Script, Make, Zapier, n8n and LLM-powered agents. Two of those years were spent as a consultant implementing Cash Application Automation at HighRadius.
about.body: I think in flows and triggers. I prefer real-world fail-first / fix-fast over textbook over-engineering, and I love it when the code that takes the smallest mental footprint quietly runs the largest workflow. Off-hours I do stand-up comedy, chase good food and travel anywhere there's a story to bring back.

experience.summary: Driving end-to-end automation of student onboarding, class allocation, attendance tracking and parent-student communication using Make.com, Zapier, n8n and Apps Script with Monday.com as the CRM backbone.

Shipped a Flutter Android app + dashboard for the Coffee Development Trust, Koraput. Built a custom LLM chatbot with RAG for an agency client at BeGig. Delivered Shopify Liquid components for Kunsquad and a WhatsApp curation bot for Nothing Bot Comedy in Bangalore.
Built end-to-end automations for onboarding, appraisal and offboarding using Make, Zapier, Apps Script and Zoho. Maintained and optimised existing scenarios for cost and reliability.
Moved to the tech team for my SQL chops and built the Apps Script Automation Projects (ASAP) suite — internal tools for managing projects, teams and data gathering, still in active use.

Implemented CAA for Zurich Insurance, CrediQ and Heritage Crystal Clean (live 2021–22). Managed two resources to deliver CAA for Bureau Veritas (live 2022). Started client work with Bank of America for faster implementations.
